correctness.rationale: Riemann–Roch gives dimension 6 and sections (1,x,x^2,x^3,x^4,y)(dx/y)^2 as a basis. The triangular Hasse derivative determinant reduces to D^(j)y. The polynomial recursion for B_j=y^(2j-1)D^(j)y gives B5=3t(t²-4)x^7(x^8-1)F, B5=B6=0 at t=0, and nonzero explicit B7. Reduced nonclassical parameter ideal follows from coefficient -3t(t²-4). Global Wronskian K^29 and valuations give eight branch points of weight4, 80 other nonbranch roots plus two zeros and two infinity points of weight1, degree116. Independent SymPy GF7 identities checked j<=7; local divisor argument is mathematical, not finite testing.
